claims.claim: Canal Cockburn is recognized by SBAP/SIMBIO as a geoform of the marine ecosystem Cockburn Magdalena - Magallanes (ECOMAR-056).
Canal Cockburn is named in the official subbasin Islas al S. Isla Sta Ines y al O. Canal Barbara y Canal Cockburn, within the basin Islas al Sur Estrecho de Magallanes.
Navigation, current, bathymetric and route guidance for Canal Cockburn must not be inferred from biodiversity-system records.
